headline: One Point One Solutions gets in-principle approval to issue 15 lakh convertible warrants to non-promoters
hook: Preferential warrant issue approved for non-promoters
summary: One Point One Solutions Limited has received in-principle approval from the exchange to issue 15,00,000 convertible warrants to non-promoters on a preferential basis. Each warrant has a face value of Rs 2 and an issue price of not less than Rs 60. This corporate action introduces new capital into the company through equity dilution. Retail investors should note how preferential allotments alter shareholding patterns.
whats_next: Final shareholder approval and warrant conversion timeline
why_it_matters: New capital coming in, but existing equity gets diluted.

headline: One Point One Solutions subscribes to subsidiary shares
hook: Subsidiary capital infusion at One Point One
summary: One Point One Solutions Limited has notified the NSE regarding the subscription of shares in its subsidiary. This disclosure is made in compliance with Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015. The move involves an internal capital allocation within the corporate structure.
